summary: NASA Earth Jukebox is an interactive, accessible web platform that transforms Earth Information Center satellite visualizations into real-time dynamic soundscapes. Developed to bridge the gap for blind and low-vision audiences, it uses computer vision to map visual elements—color spectrums, brightness, and pixel density—to musical parameters like pitch, rhythm, and spatial panning across curated scales. Featuring six authentic planetary datasets, a time-series frame scrubber, custom image sonification, and an interactive coordinate probe, the platform blends scientific rigor with artistic harmony. It includes working user authentication, live audio recording, high-contrast theming, and spoken audio descriptions to make Earth science universally accessible.
details:
NASA Earth Jukebox scans EIC satellite frames using computer vision on an HTML5 Canvas, translating visual data into real-time soundscapes via the Web Audio API. Color hues map to musical pitches across tuned scales, brightness controls dynamic filter cutoffs, and geographic coordinates drive spatial stereo panning.

Benefits & Impact:
It eliminates the visual-only barrier in STEM, empowering blind and low-vision audiences to experience Earth science while helping all users perceive subtle cyclical climate trends through multi-sensory immersion.

Tools & Technologies:
Built with vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, Web Audio API, Web Speech API (TTS narration), LocalStorage, and Node.js—with zero third-party dependencies.

Creativity:
Replaces chaotic noise with harmonious ambient synthesis, features an interactive coordinate probe for instant point-by-point sonic inspection, tailors distinct synthesizer personas to physical datasets (e.g., icy chimes, deep ocean drones), and supports custom image sonification.

Factors Considered:
Accessibility-first architecture (ARIA-live announcements, high-contrast mode, keyboard navigation), scientific ground truth (MODIS, OCO-2, VIIRS data), complete offline autonomy via a single-file build, and user engagement through working authentication, saved soundscape playlists, and live audio recording.
